body: LIVE method test (L9, L21): random draw from the cheapest EV/EBITDA tercile of a 120-name random sample of the India non-financial Rs 1,000-20,000 cr universe; no buy/sell verdict. Research, not advice. SELECTION: 809 in range -> 741 eligible -> sample 120 (Random(20261125)) -> 111 valid -> cheapest tercile 37 (EV/EBITDA <= 11.86x) -> Random(20261126) walk: JPPOWER skipped (PEAD Q1, event 19-Oct-2026), AUTOAXLES passed all v3 checks (pledge 0, unmodified audits, PEAD Q5 SUE +4.19, solvency 0 flags). WHY CHEAP: cyclical peak, not fraud or solvency. P/E 12.9x trailing (record EPS 137.6 adj; record OPM 12.5% in Q2 FY27) vs 25.8x on 10-year normalised EPS 68.9; FY26 M&HCV industry ~480k = FY19 peak; FY27 guided 500k+ with a regulatory pre-buy to April 2027; capacity ~98% used; last cycle revenue -53%, EPS -81%, price -80% (2018-20). KEY FINDINGS: (1) since 1-Apr-2025 AAL sells direct to OEMs and pays Meritor HVS (India) (Cummins) a technical fee, Rs 97.5 cr FY26 = 4.5% of sales = 41% of core EBITDA, under a one-year agreement renewable 30-Apr-2027, after minorities rejected a Rs 2,500 cr material-RPT resolution 79.5% against (Dec-2024); (2) the switch grossed revenue up ~5% (materials 71.0% -> 67.5% of revenue), so FY26 like-for-like revenue was ~flat vs industry +16%; (3) Customer A = 66% of revenue; (4) net cash Rs 394 cr (15% of mcap), ICRA AA-, ROIC 15-22% FY23-26; (5) promise ledger 43% vs auto-peer median 60%: dates slip, industry forecasts too bearish twice. VALUATION: worksheet v1.3 EV 1.49x raw / 1.40x anchored (w=0.6) vs hurdle 1.76x -> card v1.2 size 0; base IRR 10.4%; exit-bet table 1.13x (DCF P/E) / 1.49x / 1.73x (own median 18.8). METHOD LESSONS: cheap tercile selects cycle position; materials-ratio test for sales-model gross-ups; minority vote results are governance data.
title: Automotive Axles (AUTOAXLES) - LIVE deep dive #3, first cheap-tercile draw (protocol v1.3 stages 2-7): method test, no verdict; card size 0; 6 live calls
